data.notes: November 2026 is stacked in and around CDMX, with major international festivals, Día de Muertos club programming, and strong electronic/Latin concert traffic.

events.title: Corona Capital 2026
events.summary: Corona Capital CDMX is confirmed for November 20, 21 and 22 at Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. The official site notes that the 2026 poster is live and tickets are linked through Ticketmaster.

events.title: Coca-Cola Flow Fest 2026
events.summary: Coca-Cola Flow Fest returns to Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez on November 28 and 29. The official information page confirms the dates, venue and festival hours of 2:00 p.m.–2:00 a.m.

events.title: Ultra Mexico 2026
events.summary: Ultra Mexico is confirmed for November 7–8, 2026. The official Ultra Mexico site and ticket page list two-day GA and VIP passes for the 2026 edition.

events.title: Time Warp Mexico 2026
events.summary: Time Warp lands in Mexico City for the first time at Expo Santa Fe. The official lineup includes Ben Klock b2b Alarico, The Blessed Madonna, DJ Stingray 313 b2b Helena Hauff, DVS1, Maceo Plex, Sven Väth, DJ Tennis b2b Seth Troxler, Indira Paganotto and Reinier Zonneveld live.

events.title: Hipnosis Festival 2026
events.summary: Hipnosis Festival returns to Quarry Studios on November 7. The confirmed lineup includes Connan Mockasin, Fontän, Future Islands, Jonathan Bree, Kim Gordon, Levitation Room, Melvins, The Lemon Twigs, Wine Lips and YHWH Nailgun.

events.title: Karol G — Viajando por el Mundo, Tropitour
events.summary: Karol G brings the Viajando por el Mundo, Tropitour to Estadio GNP Seguros. Ticketmaster confirms the November 13, 9:00 p.m. Mexico City stadium show.

events.title: CIRCOLOCO CDMX
events.summary: Circoloco’s official site confirms its CDMX event at Estadio Fray Nano on November 28. The event runs 4:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. with general sale access listed.

events.title: NOCTURNE E22
events.summary: MUTEK MX closes its Edición 22 cycle with a NOCTURNE program at Maravilla Studios. The bill includes Dasha Rush, Jump Source, OK EG, Valesuchi, Lorenzo Senni, Kelly Moran, Crystallmess, Alif Hilal and more.

events.title: Festival Amigo 2026
events.summary: Festival Amigo takes place just outside CDMX in Cuautitlán Izcalli on November 7. The confirmed lineup includes Julieta Venegas, Caifanes, Los Amigos Invisibles, DLD, Porter, Los Mesoneros, Disco Bahía and Fármacos.

events.title: Mac DeMarco — Road to Hipnosis: Dreaming
events.summary: Hipnosis presents Mac DeMarco at Quarry Studios as Road to Hipnosis: Dreaming. The Fever ticket page confirms the November 6 show, 7:00 p.m. start, and Quarry Studios venue.

events.title: Ofrenda Montelobos 2026
events.summary: Ofrenda Montelobos is confirmed at Frontón Bucareli on November 7. Songkick lists SG Lewis and Satori on the bill for the Mexico City event.

events.title: Lila Downs
events.summary: Lila Downs plays Auditorio Nacional on November 1. The Ticketmaster listing confirms the 7:00 p.m. CDMX date at the Auditorio Nacional.

events.title: LooLoo Anniversary with Dennis Cruz
events.summary: LooLoo Studio's anniversary night brings Spanish tech-house producer Dennis Cruz to Juárez with resident Alexandthere on support.

events.title: Brown Sugar Rewind
events.summary: Diaspora-focused rooftop party billed as one of Mexico City's biggest Black-music-only parties, with hip-hop, R&B, dancehall and afro-beats from Dj Dizam, Black Daria, Ramses Hurt, 2KN, Wizah and The Bradley Way.

events.title: CÓSMICA presenta: 1tbsp en CDMX · Día de Muertos
events.summary: CÓSMICA brings Australian left-field dance producer 1tbsp to Antro Juan for Día de Muertos. Cherry Chola, Chico Sonido, Mau Moctezuma and Epidemic Of Boringness are also listed.

events.title: RaiNao
events.summary: Puerto Rican artist RaiNao is confirmed at Lunario del Auditorio Nacional on November 18. The venue page highlights the show as an energetic, innovative live proposal.

events.title: Helado Tropical — Helado Negro & Reyna Tropical
events.summary: Helado Negro and Reyna Tropical bring their Helado Tropical project to Lunario del Auditorio Nacional. Ticketmaster confirms the November 26, 8:30 p.m. Mexico City date.

events.title: TRYM
events.summary: French hard-techno/rave figure TRYM is listed for a FerMX/LooLoo-linked Sala Urbana date, positioned as one of the month's heavier electronic nights.

events.title: Morat — YEM World Tour
events.summary: Morat is confirmed at Palacio de los Deportes on November 6, 2026. The Mexico City date is part of the Colombian pop group’s YEM World Tour listings.

events.title: Los Auténticos Decadentes + Los Caligaris
events.summary: Los Auténticos Decadentes and Los Caligaris are confirmed for Estadio GNP Seguros on November 27, 2026. The Ticketmaster listing names the stadium event as Los Auténticos Caligaris.

events.title: The Hayley Williams Show
events.summary: Hayley Williams is confirmed for Auditorio Nacional on November 23, 2026. The Ticketmaster page lists Annie DiRusso as the special guest.

events.title: Babasónicos
events.summary: Babasónicos is confirmed for Palacio de los Deportes on November 25, 2026. Ticketmaster lists the Argentine band’s Mexico City show at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Jeff Mills CDMX 2026 — YuYu 9th Anniversary with Dorado
events.summary: Dorado and YuYu present Detroit techno pioneer Jeff Mills at Frontón Bucareli, marking 30 years of his influential The Liquid Room Tokyo set and YuYu’s 9th anniversary in CDMX.

events.title: Aitana
events.summary: Spanish pop artist Aitana is confirmed for Auditorio Nacional on November 6, 2026. Ticketmaster lists the Mexico City performance at 8:30 p.m.

events.title: ZZ Top
events.summary: ZZ Top is confirmed for Auditorio Nacional on November 11, 2026. The Ticketmaster event page lists the concert in Ciudad de México at 9:00 p.m.

events.title: FASCiNOMA Festival | Dance Music Weekend 2026
events.summary: Independent open-air dance music weekend in Tlalpan centered on dub and its club mutations, with confirmed names including Surgeon, Donato Dozzy, Sicaria, Introspekt, Sully, re:ni, Intrusion, Vladimir Ivkovic, Debit, Verraco and local selectors.

events.title: Jerry Rivera
events.summary: Salsa singer Jerry Rivera is confirmed for Auditorio Nacional on November 17, 2026. Ticketmaster lists the Mexico City concert at 8:30 p.m.

events.title: Christian Sands Quartet
events.venueName: Teatro de la Ciudad Esperanza Iris
events.summary: Christian Sands Quartet is confirmed for Teatro de la Ciudad Esperanza Iris on November 21, 2026. Ticketmaster categorizes the performance under jazz/instrumental concerts.
